tagline: ePlus inc. is a leading provider of technology solutions and services, leveraging partnerships with world-class technology vendors to deliver integrated AI, cloud, security, and emerging technology solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: ePlus generates $2.07 billion in net sales, reflecting its position as a leading provider of integrated technology solutions. This key metric measures the size and reach of the company in critical areas such as security, cloud, AI, and emerging technologies.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Decline in sales, potentially due to pricing pressures and project delays.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Improvement in gross margin, despite lower net sales.

kpis.name: Operating Income Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Consolidated operating income margin for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.explanation: Total profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Consolidated net earnings for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Net Sales - Technology Business
kpis.explanation: Revenue from product, professional services, and managed services segments.
kpis.description: Net sales from the technology business for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Net Sales - Financing Business
kpis.explanation: Revenue from IT equipment, software, and services financing activities.
kpis.description: Net sales from the financing business for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Complementary financing segment in growth, meeting customer financing needs.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP measure of operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation, and unusual items.
kpis.description: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, excluding one-time items and acquisition-related expenses.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the company's adjusted operational performance.

kpis.name: Focus on Managed Cloud Solutions
kpis.explanation: ePlus is building a portfolio of managed cloud services to help customers manage costs, security, and skills in the cloud.
kpis.description: ePlus has developed a comprehensive Cloud Managed Services approach to address growing customer challenges in cost, security, and technical skills.
kpis.signal: Indicator of strategic focus on cloud and managed services.

kpis.name: Customer Priorities: AI, Security, Cloud
kpis.explanation: ePlus customers prioritize investments in AI, security, and cloud solutions for digital transformation.
kpis.description: ePlus has developed advisory services, assessments, solutions, and professional and managed services to meet customer priorities in AI, security, cloud solutions, and digital modernization.
kpis.signal: Strategic alignment of ePlus offerings with key market trends.

kpis.name: Professional Services Growth
kpis.explanation: Professional services are experiencing significant growth, reflecting increased demand for consulting and transformation services.
kpis.description: Professional services revenue for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025, up 48.1% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in advisory and integration services, a core strategic business.

ai_positioning.summary: ePlus positions itself as an AI solution integrator, leveraging technologies from leading partners to meet customer needs. The company is developing services and solutions to support customers in their AI adoption journey, focusing on priorities such as security and cloud.
evidence: Our technology solutions leverage third-party hardware, software, maintenance and other services with our own advanced professional and managed services.
Our solutions are comprised of world class leading technologies from partners such as NVIDIA, AWS, Microsoft, Dell EMC, Cisco Systems, and others.

Underpinning the broader areas of cloud, security, AI, networking, data center and collaboration are specific skills in orchestration and automation, application modernization, DevSecOps, zero-trust architectures, data management, data visualization, analytics, network modernization, edge computing, consumption licensing models, and other advanced and emerging technologies.
Our customers top focus areas include AI, security, cloud solutions, as well as digital transformation and modernization.
We have developed advisory services, assessments, solutions, and professional and managed services to meet these priorities and help our customers attain and maintain their desired outcome.
